en.headline: 9 own commits plus 10 bot commits in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu; issue #9 closed
en.summary: All activity was in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, with **9 own commits** plus 10 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The own commits added AI all-failure auto diagnosis with a manual `/oc` re-check entry, fixed the `opencode.yml` `if` condition that used the unsupported `toLower`, fixed activity event pagination so HTTP 422 is no longer treated as fatal (using the `Link` header instead), and adjusted the verify summary window assertion so it no longer hard-compares against the current day. Two temporary acceptance changes were made to force a real failure — a nonexistent model id on the three legs and a nonexistent login account on the `/oc` login gate — and were then reverted, with the codemap baseline refreshed twice, to `46667bc` and `4719825`. Issue #9, titled `[test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）`, was opened, commented on three times, and then closed, giving 5 issue actions in total for the day. `github-actions[bot]` replied twice on that issue, including a `pong` referencing run 39153131747 and a note that `data/ai-diagnosis.md` recorded no failed AI leg because no AI attempt had run at diagnosis time. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussion activity were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 9 次本人提交加 10 次机器人提交，issue #9 已关闭
zh.summary: 当日活动全部集中在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`：**9 次本人提交**，另有 10 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。本人提交新增了 AI 全失败自动诊断与 `/oc` 手动补查入口，修复了 `opencode.yml` 中 `if` 使用不被支持的 `toLower` 的问题，修正活动事件分页使 HTTP 422 不再被视为致命错误（改以 `Link` 头为准），并调整 verify 的 summary 窗口断言，不再与「此刻的今天」硬比。两处临时验收改动（三条腿改用不存在的 model id、`/oc` 登录门改为不存在的账号）用于制造真实失败，随后已回滚，codemap 基线也两次刷新到 `46667bc` 与 `4719825`。Issue #9「[test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）」被新开、评论 3 次后关闭，当日 issue 活动共 5 条。`github-actions[bot]` 在该 issue 回复 2 次，包括一次附带 run 39153131747 的 `pong`，以及说明 `data/ai-diagnosis.md` 未记录任何失败 AI 腿、因为诊断运行时根本没有 AI 尝试。当日没有 PR、review、release 或讨论活动。
